item.title: BiovaCo Nexus Private Limited Announces Commencement of Business from 15 July 2026
item.description: BiovaCo Nexus Private Limited officially announces the commencement of its business operations from 15 July 2026, marking the beginning of its mission to deliver innovative solutions in biotechnology, agriculture, and food technology.

item.title: BiovaCo Nexus Private Limited Officially Incorporated to Drive Innovation Across Biotechnology, Agriculture, and Food Technology
item.description: BiovaCo Nexus Private Limited has been officially incorporated in India with a mission to develop innovative and sustainable solutions across biotechnology, agriculture, and food technology through research, technology, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
